notes: Ordered onboarding questions. Data, not prompts: an organisation can add, remove or reorder questions here without editing any skill. The onboarding skill asks the next unanswered question (impactos interview --action next) one per turn, reads any file the helper points at before asking (read-before-ask), and records the answer (impactos interview --action answer). 'reads_from' lists what to parse or read first; 'records_to' is where the confirmed answer is written.

questions.why: Names the deployment in the operating notes and source map.

questions.prompt: Which reporting period are we preparing (for example 2026-06-30)?
questions.why: The period label every parse, mapping and export is scoped to.

questions.prompt: Which public funder framework are you reporting toward (for example CED 2024-2028)? This is an anchor only; no agreement text is stored.
questions.why: Records the cited framework the export helps satisfy; see docs/reporting-anchors.md.

questions.prompt: Point me at one export from each system where the organisation keeps its data (companies/beneficiaries, programs and cohorts, funding, meetings). I will read each file and show you what I found before asking anything else.
questions.why: Read-before-ask: parse each pointed-at file so later questions are confirmations, not blind asks.

questions.prompt: Confirm where company/beneficiary records live and how they are exported (system name and export method).
questions.why: SR-04: the source map states location and export method per data type.

questions.prompt: Who owns the company data source? Give a name or a role only, never contact details.
questions.why: SR-04: owner recorded by name or role; the PII scan rejects contact details.

questions.prompt: Which column in the company export is the stable identifier that stays the same across periods? If there is none, say so.
questions.why: SR-05: a source with no stable identifier is a missing required field and changes the route.

questions.prompt: Where do coaching meetings and interactions live, and which notetaker exports them (Fireflies, Granola, Fathom)?
questions.why: SR-04 / D-14: interactions have no home system; they route to the store.
reads_from: a sample transcript export (impactos parse --type transcript)

questions.prompt: Where do programs and cohorts live, and how are they exported?
questions.why: SR-04: programs/cohorts are reference data with their own source.

questions.prompt: Where do funding events live? Does that source keep the full dated history with a stable identifier and declared amounts?
questions.why: SR-05: funding is a conditional route; the answer decides stay vs store.

questions.prompt: Where are diverse-group / demographic flags recorded, if at all? We record only where they live; we never infer them from names, free text, or anything else.
questions.why: Standing rule: never infer demographics. The source map states where such data lives, not the values.

questions.prompt: Which milestone track applies by default (software, hardware, medical-device, biotech)? This is an author-declared deployment constant, never inferred.
questions.why: Seeds workspace/state/reference.json so mappings can convert funder stages to rungs.

questions.prompt: Review the route recommendation per data type (impactos interview --action route) and choose, for each, whether it stays in its existing system or moves to the optional store.
questions.why: SR-05: the recommendation follows the fixed rule; the person's choice is recorded in operating-notes/routes.md.
